Exercises "show playlist membership" end-to-end against mocks/data.js's playlistsPage (2 playlists: "My Favourites" contains in-playlist-track; "Techno 2026" contains in-playlist-track AND recent-repost-track): the initial crawl, badging, and live add/remove/delete sync via a fake XMLHttpRequest (this session's tooling can't drive a real network PUT/DELETE, so the fake XHR lets content/features/playlistMembership.js's real patch-and-diff logic run against a script-triggered request instead).
